BRAD BILTON

By: Sian Clark | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
A con artist who stalks his victims on FACEBOOK

Summary:
Brad Bilton con Artist. The scam is that he Uses Facebook to find his victims. He joins groups such as Traffic Alert and Hijacking Alerts and then he responds to the post. He claims to own a company called MEDRA and says his security guys can assist with a bulletin to find the car. A few days later the person gets a phone call to say the car is found in another province and is asked for money to get the car returned to a local police station. When the person goes to the station there is no car and no Brad and no investigating officer. There are 52 cases of fraud against him. He has also scammed The Ark Animal charity centre out of money for fire extinguishers and a MEDICAL aid course he was pretending to run. There is a closed FB group of People who have all been scammed by him and are helping with this investigation.

Press Release:


Clever Con Caught
He's been described as charming, sweet, and kind. But in reality he’s a con artist who trawls Facebook to scam vulnerable women out of thousands. Responding to posts on Traffic News and hijacking alert groups, he claims to be able to find stolen cars for a fee. Desperate victims pay, then realise too late that they’ve been conned. But a closed Facebook group of victims has finally ended his 20-year trail of deceit. Carte Blanche exposes a conniving con artist.


Script:


CARTE BLANCHE BRAD BILTON
TX: Sunday 24TH January 2016
Voice: Devi Sankaree Govender



So your car gets stolen or you’re in a hit and run … perhaps you get hijacked … you post a photograph and details on Facebook hoping that someone, somewhere sees it and sends you information. What you don’t expect is an experienced con artist trawling those same Facebook pages searching for his next victim.

UP SOUND; LISA
00.02.I then got a message from Brad Bilton


Up sound Benita
00.00.50 Bradley Roberts 0.01.00

Up sound: Tessa
00.02.4 mr brad bilton called me
UP SOUND: LISA sayingthat he could help … 00.02.07

DEVI LINK 1
A man of many names Bradford and Bradley .. Bilton and Roberts. Whatever name he was known by , there was no question that Brad Bilton was a beacon of hope for these young woman. But instead of helping them - he took advantage.

Tessa Davis had a sentimental attachment to her 1999 Toyota Corolla. It belonged to her gran who had passed away a year ago. In June last year the car was stolen from out side her home in Centurion. She posted an alert on a well established Hijacking and Traffic news Facebook page which shares information on traffic incidents to it’s nearly 19 000 members.

UP SOUND: TESSA
I immediately went on all face book sites I am part of just to alert people to be on the look out that if if they do see car by any chance or spot it and they can give us any information … 00.01.57




00.02.4 mr brad bilton called me stated he was a from a private security company called bbsa .. which worked with reputable tracking companies to locate your car 00.02.16


Tessa was thrilled when Brad Bilton told her the car had been found in Musina, Limpopo and he needed R3000 for transportation costs to get it back to Pretoria.

Devi link
Brad Bilton promised Tessa that for R3000 he would recover her stolen vehicle in Musina and have it delivered here to this impound lot in Wierda Park. Tessa had no reason to doubt it.
When Tessa paid the money Brad assured her he was already driving to Musina to collect her car. The next morning she phoned Brad who confirmed that her car was at the Pretoria impound lot.

UP SOUND: TESSA 00.14. 04 So my father and I go into the impound lot and we go through their records .. to see if a car of our description came in on either Friday on Saturday … and then they had no record of it .. 00.14.17

00.26.23 honestly I can’t believe that this guy took advantage of us..

Kempton Park resident Lisa Peach had been in an accident and her car had been towed away. It had incurred towing and storage fees for over R25 000 which Lisa couldn’t afford. So she vented her frustration on Facebook. Brad spotted her post and came to her rescue.

Up sound Lisa Peach:
00.02.21 I asked how much .. he said about R3000 .. to do what …. to use his connections and get car released … from there I had to pay R1500 deposit ..00.02.46


Lisa paid it. Brad referred Lisa to his face book page - Medra RSA - a roadside assistance company. He also claimed to be a private investigator. Then Brad confirmed that he had negotiated a reduction in Lisa’s storage fees and asked for another payment, which she paid.



UP SOUND LISA:
00.03.20 I was praising him I really was … so I wanted to go get car myself and he said he would get it delivered and I thought what nice guy 00.03.42


Then things changed - Brad claimed he was having ongoing meetings with the owners of the storage yard and they were now requesting an additional R10 000. Unbeknown to him Lisa visited the yard owner herself and was in for a surprise.




UP SOUND: LISA PEACH
00.07.07 I walked in so now I speak to this wernon and he laughed he doesn’t know of any Bradford Bilton … and that I had been scammed 00.07.32


Carte Blanche confirmed that the owners and staff of the Storage yard had never negotiated or met or had any dealings with anyone by the name of Brad Bilton on behalf of Lisa Peach.

A Furious Lisa contacted Brad and demanded a refund. He agreed and sent her a proof of payment from his bank account. When the funds didn’t clear Lisa contacted the bank’s fraud department.

UP SOUND: LISA

00.11.25 what Nedbank explained to me was what he did was …. he opened an account and then he did a future dated payment … and you don’t activate it so he print screened that and sent it to me. … he had paid me but he hadn’t ….
She had just got over that shock when Brad dealt his next blow.

UP SOUND: He was just trying to scare me.
00.17.40 he sent me an email saying civil charges and identity theft … he opened cases at Randfontein police station to the crime office … I must come with a lawyer has civil and crime charges against me … laid charges for 00.18.06

DEVI LINK:
All Brad’s victims describe him as, intelligent, persuasive and charming. Typical traits it would seem of a con artist.


ANNI
00.00.55 Such a person would be very very confident, a pathaological liar, VERY INFLATED SELF ESTEEM, OPPORTUNIST, ambitious


Criminologist, Professor Anni Hesselink says a scamster often pretends to have the solution to a victim’s problems. He then uses this power to install a sense of security and trust in them.


00.05.44 the person like that needs to be inherently deviant and selfish not care for other people and harm and damage they cause to other people. it’s a person that is so narcisstic and so self centred .. a person that is extremely sociable no social conscience .. it’s a person that is just self centred. 00.06.12


UP SOUND: LISA PEACH
00.16. 40 He is looking for these people who are in desparate situations that needs help.

UP SOUND: TESS DAVIS
00.03. 32 he asks all the right questions … he sounded very professional


Andre
00.06.27 this is a typical kind of trait of a con artist he comes out very strong. very forcefully and very aggressively .

Andre Snyman of e-blockwatch – a community crime fighting social media site formed a Facebook group called HOW BAD IS BAD BRAD. The group now has 84 members whose complaints date back to 2008.


00.02.15 and that flushes him out … 6 degrees of separation .. put into group and chat … 00.02.37


Springs resident Benita Black found the Facebook group after Brad conned her into believing he could find her hijacked car.



BENITA BLACK
00.00.45 a guy by name of Bradley Roberts contacted me via facebook he basically said to can we recover it for you. 00.01.03

He would charge her R3500 excluding vat and told Benita to check out his company Facebook page called Medra Group. This was different to the Medra Road Side Assistance site seen by Tessa Davis. It looked legit to Benita so she paid.

UP SOUND: BENITA
00.02.57 he promised me to have my car back two days later. 00.03.06 00.03.36 a week or two went past then I contacted again I said Bradley what is going on … he said no to get the paper work quicker .. cost extra R1000 00.03.54

Benita paid the money and arranged to meet Brad Bilton at the Midrand Police Station to get the paperwork sorted out.


BENITA 007
00.03.33 I was there at about 11am … from 11 morning and hoping .. waited for bradford til 6pm 00.03.44

Brad’s telephone excuses for his non arrival included client emergencies and traffic congestion.

SOUND: BENITA 004
00.04.40 and that’s when I knew I had been scammed 00.04.45


Now the amounts may seem small but Carte Blanche discovered that this 41 year old con man Brad Bilton has been involved in 52 cases of fraud and theft which spans over 20 years.

IN 1992 his infamous career began in KZN when he was sentenced by the Military Police and served time for making bomb threats.



During the late 90s his trail of deeds stretched far and wide.

He has been sentenced 13 times spending nearly 24 months in jail.

Charges for theft and fraud appear in the early part of 2004 and continue throughout Limpopo and Gauteng up to present day.

ANNI 00.05.44 a person like that needs to be inherently deviant and selfish not care for other people and harm and damage they cause to other people.

ANDRE SECOND INTERVIEW:
00.09.25 he continuously does this to so many people and he destroys lives he doesn’t realize how he is destroying lives …

It was time to act. For Over 6 months we tried to track him down through addresses he had used but they turned out to be shopping centres or empty veld. Then for a few months Brad Bilton went into hiding.

Throughout this time Carte Blanche worked with members of the Facebook Groups and the SAPS to track him down.

In October he was spotted having lunch in a Krugersdorp restaurant. And an alert was sent out.

The next day Brad Bilton was arrested and escorted to the Honeydew Police station where he was charged with fraud.


UP SOUND DEVI: so after months of investigation brad bilton has finally been arrested – the details we still have to get from the police but something at least has happened.



Brad Bilton has had his day in court. He pleaded guilty to some of the charges of fraud against him. He is currently serving a 12 month sentence. His court appearances will be ongoing as he continues to face further charges.

Tessa davis
00.23.55 he messed with the wrong ladies this time 00.23.58




PROMO ONE:
A con artist involved in 52 cases of theft and fraud across the country and spanning over 20 years. CARTE BLANCHE joined a Facebook group and helped his victims track him down.
UP SOUND: TESSA DAVIS
A 00.23.55 he messed with the wrong ladies this time 00.23.58


PROMO TWO:
You post a photograph and details on Facebook of your missing vehicle hoping someone, somewhere can help. What you don’t expect is a con artist searching for his next victim.
UP sound: Tess Davis 00.26.23 honestly I can’t believe that this guy took advantage of us..

PROMO THREE:
His victims describe him as charming and caring. But his criminal career spans 20 years. Who is Brad Bilton?

He claims to own a company called MEDRA and says his security guys can assist with a bulletin to find the car. A few days later the person gets a phone call to say the car is found in another province and is asked for money to get the car returned to a local police station. When the person goes to the station there is no car and no Brad and no investigating officer. There are 52 cases of fraud against him. He has also scammed The Ark Animal charity centre out of money for fire extinguishers and a MEDICAL aid course he was pretending to run. There is a closed FB group of People who have all been scammed by him and are helping with this investigation.
